aid_dates.title: Pomona — Financial Aid Application Materials and Deadlines

test_policy.notes: Test optional: students choose whether to self-report SAT or ACT scores; unreported scores are not considered even if sent. If ACT is submitted, the Core ACT plus Science is required (sections are superscored). Official scores are needed only from enrolling students.

requirements.notes: $80 fee, waived through the Pomona Access Pass form. Pomona-specific essays: 150-word academic interest statement plus a 250-word short response. Two core-subject teacher letters; school report and counselor recommendation; mid-year report by Feb 15. Applicants from non-English-medium schools must submit TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo. Interview policy not confirmed; third-party InitialView/Vericant/Duolingo interviews are optional supplements. International aid applicants file the CSS Profile (code 4607) or, if the fee is a burden, Pomona's International Financial Aid Application.

deadlines.label: Early Decision I
deadlines.notes: Notification 'by' Dec 15; reply Jan 1. Caution: the overview table does not print a year and some Pomona admissions pages still say 'Fall 2026 admission'. Pomona's Nov 8 / Jan 8 dates are fixed each year, but confirm them with the college. Financial aid forms due Nov 15.

deadlines.label: Early Decision II
deadlines.notes: Notification 'by' Feb 15; reply March 1. The page gives no year; confirm the date with the college. Financial aid forms due Jan 15.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision
deadlines.notes: Notification 'by' April 1; reply May 1. The page gives no year; confirm the date with the college. Financial aid forms due Jan 15.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required if English is not the primary language of instruction at your secondary school. Accepts TOEFL iBT (incl. Special Home Edition), TOEFL ITP Plus for China, IELTS or Duolingo; self-reported scores allowed, official report required on enrolling. Sub-scores have no minimum. The listed values are described as minimum scores for admission.

english.notes: Minimum for iBT and iBT Special Home Edition (old 0-120 scale). TOEFL ITP Plus for China Solution: 627.
The number comes from a '5 - Minimum TOEFL' statistic on the international page. The page does not state the scale, so it is assumed to be the new 1-6 scale; confirm with the college.

aid.notes: Admission is need-aware for international applicants, but Pomona meets 100% of demonstrated need of every admitted international student, without loans in the package. No merit or athletic scholarships. Aid must be requested when applying; it cannot be added after the admission application is submitted. About 41% of international students receive aid (average nearly $74,000/yr).
